headline: Brazilian real slides against US dollar amid fiscal concerns
summary: The Brazilian real depreciated by 2.9% against the US dollar, reaching a 19-month high for the greenback, as markets react to fiscal uncertainty and Fed rate expectations.
why: The exchange rate of the Brazilian real is a key indicator of investor confidence in the country's fiscal policy and macroeconomic stability.

impacts.name: Brazilian Real
impacts.why: Fiscal concerns and global rate pressures are weakening the currency.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors are demanding higher risk premiums due to concerns over Brazil's fiscal trajectory and the impact of rising US interest rates on emerging markets.
